text.en: Don't be afraid to ask questions. Everyone here was new once.
Write things down — names, tools, where things live. Your notes will save you hours.
Keep your calendar open and turn on reminders — meetings move around a lot.
Take real breaks. Good ideas often turn up away from the screen.
